mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE id=#{jobId} AND user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT status FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE id=#{jobId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM studyroom_runs r JOIN study_rooms s ON s.current_run_id=r.id WHERE r.id=#{runId} AND r.user_id=#{userId}
SELECT * FROM studyroom_generation_calls WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND attempt=#{attempt} AND phase=#{phase}
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_generation_calls SET request_context_json=#{contextJson} WHERE id=#{callId}
UPDATE studyroom_generation_calls SET status='SUCCEEDED',response_json=#{responseJson},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{callId} AND status='SENT'
UPDATE studyroom_generation_calls SET status='FAILED',failure_code='MODEL_EXECUTION_FAILED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{callId} AND status='SENT'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM studyroom_fragment_versions WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND revision=#{revision} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_fragment_versions SET consumed_calls=consumed_calls+1,consumed_tokens=consumed_tokens+#{tokens} WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND revision=#{revision}
UPDATE studyroom_fragment_versions SET consumed_tokens=consumed_tokens+#{tokenDelta},active_duration_ms=active_duration_ms+#{elapsedMs} WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND revision=#{revision}
